description: This file defines the `CameraPreviewFragment` class, a Fragment that manages camera preview display in an Android application. It handles camera initialization, permission checks, and resource release, specifically for displaying camera feed and handling unavailable camera scenarios.

classes.name: CameraPreviewFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a camera preview and handles camera resource management, including permission handling, availability checking, and release of camera resources.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of CameraPreviewFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates the layout and initializes the camera preview if the camera is available.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Lifecycle method that releases the camera resources when the fragment is paused.

methods.name: getCameraInstance
methods.description: Static method to safely obtain a Camera object instance for a given camera ID.

methods.name: releaseCamera
methods.description: Releases the camera resource if it is currently held.
